mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_history (user_id, question_id, question_title, user_code, result, expected_output, actual_output, error_message, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{questionTitle}, #{userCode}, #{result}, #{expectedOutput}, #{actualOutput}, #{errorMessage}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result = 'correct'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as week, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'correct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as correct FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{weeks} WEEK) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY week ASC

SELECT kp.knowledge_point as knowledgePoint, COUNT(h.id) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN h.result = 'correct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as correct FROM c_questions kp LEFT JOIN quiz_history h ON h.question_id = kp.id AND h.user_id = #{userId} WHERE kp.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT question_id FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY kp.knowledge_point ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND result = 'correct'
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as total FROM quiz_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC
